summary: Feed s084_single is degraded: 77.2% of TCP sessions are one-way (139/180), IDS requires bidirectional traffic for stateful detection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker/SPAN is delivering only one direction per flow - likely a single-direction SPAN/TAP or asymmetric routing without bidirectional aggregation, so the return direction is sent elsewhere or dropped before the IDS.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs_both_directions=true for TCP reassembly and signature matching; with only one side it cannot track handshakes, reassemble streams, or detect exploits/C2 responses, causing missed detections and incomplete alerts.

recommended_fix.why: Aggregate both directions of each 5-tuple flow to the same IDS tool port so stateful inspection sees complete sessions.
